blocks.prompt: 13. If three consecutive numbers in A.P. are increased by 1, 4, 15 respectively, the resulting numbers are in G.P. Find the original numbers if their sum is 6.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bilkul Sawal 12 jaisa hai, bas is dafa minus ki jagah jama (add) karna hai.
Diya kya hai? A.P. ke teen terms ka sum 6, aur 1, 4, 15 jama karne par G.P.
Find kya karna hai? Asal teen numbers.
Plan: \(a - d, a, a + d\); sum se \(a\), G.P. ki sharait se \(d\). Sawal 12 ko saamne rakh kar pehle khud try kijiye.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: A.P. ke teen terms, sum 6; 1, 4, 15 jama karne par G.P.
Humein find karna hai: A.P. ke terms.
Tareeqa: Phir se \(a - d, a, a + d\) chunenge, taake sum mein \(d\) cancel ho jaye aur \(a\) seedha mil jaye.

Sum se \(a\)
\[3a = 6 \Rightarrow a = 2\]
Kyun: \((a - d) + a + (a + d) = 3a\), kyunke \(d\) cancel ho jata hai. Beech wala term average hai: \(6 \div 3 = 2\).

1, 4, 15 jama karein
\[2 - d + 1 = 3 - d\]
\[2 + 4 = 6\]
\[2 + d + 15 = 17 + d\]
Kyun: Pehle term mein 1, doosre mein 4, teesre mein 15, sawal wali tarteeb mein jama kiye.

G.P. ki sharait lagayein
\[6^2 = (3 - d)(17 + d)\]
\[36 = 51 - 14d - d^2\]
\[d^2 + 14d - 15 = 0\]
Kyun: Beech wale ka square = pehla \(\times\) teesra. Bracket khola: \(3 \cdot 17 = 51\), \(3d - 17d = -14d\), \(-d \cdot d = -d^2\). Sab ko ek taraf le gaye: \(d^2 + 14d + 36 - 51 = 0\).
Dhyan dein: \(3d - 17d\) ka sign negative hai; yahan sign ki ghalti poora jawab badal deti hai.

\(d\) nikalein
\[(d + 15)(d - 1) = 0\]
\[d = 1 \text{ or } d = -15\]
Kyun: Product \(-15\) aur sum \(14\) wale numbers \(15\) aur \(-1\) hain, is liye factors \((d + 15)(d - 1)\).

Numbers likhein
\[d = 1:\ 1, 2, 3\]
\[d = -15:\ 17, 2, -13\]
Kyun: \(a = 2\) aur \(d\) ki dono values rakhin. \(2 - (-15) = 17\) aur \(2 + (-15) = -13\). Dono jaaiz jawab hain.

Tasdeeq
\[1, 2, 3 \to 2, 6, 18\ (r = 3)\]
\[17, 2, -13 \to 18, 6, 2\ (r = \tfrac{1}{3})\]
Kyun: Dono sets ka sum 6 hai, dono A.P. hain (farq 1 aur \(-15\)), aur 1, 4, 15 jama karne par dono G.P. ban jate hain.
